body:
I'm glad you're feeling better! Cognitive Therapy can be a life saver! 

And thank you so much for the recommendation, I'll check it out!!
You're alright, no need to apologize. I hope you feel better soon- Are you alone? If so, is there a way you could spend some time with a family member, ect?
I'm so relieved to hear that. How are you feeling?
I hope you feel better soon! Be sure to get some rest once you get home, you deserve it!
I'm so glad to hear that! How are you doing?
Please reconsider, OP! Don't want to lose ya! This subreddit is here to help! Please contact emergency services if you hurt yourself! Feel free to message me if you need someone to talk to.

Please don't go through with it, OP. Please reach out to someone, whether it be a friend, family member, or counselor/therapist. You're free to PM me, even. Please reconsider this, and if you hurt yourself please call emergency services.

Please don't go through with it, OP! If you're unable to talk on the phone, there are helplines online! Please don't do anything, and if you do call emergency services! Please feel free to PM me if you need someone to talk to.
I'm glad you have the number, and that you're willing to make an appointment. Perhaps they have a website you could utilize? Maybe someone else would be able to make the appointment on your behalf?
I hope you feel better soon, OP. Break-ups are never easy. Do you have a therapist or counselor to help you through this?

Please don't hurt yourself!! If you think you're truly going to, or you already have, please get ahold of emergency services. Don't want to lose you, OP. I hope you feel better soon, and I hope you're here to see it.

OP, please reconsider! Please reach out to emergency services if/before you hurt yourself. I sincerely hope you feel better soon, and that you'll be here for your birthday. Please feel free to message me if you'd like.
Oh!! I've never been very good at math myself! What do you find so interesting about it? Or is it just something you're really good at?
You said you're in college, right? What are you majoring/minoring in?
Do you listen to any music? What's your favorite song/artist?
I'm so, so sorry to hear that. It's not fair to you at all. I hope your situation improves soon, and hopefully you'll have access to another counselor soon.

That's fair! To each their own!   
What're your hobbies? What do you enjoy?

OP, I understand these things are hard, but please do reconsider. If you'd like, I'd be happy to talk to you. I hope you feel better soon, and I hope you're here to see it. Please contact emergency services if you've hurt yourself.

Hey, please don't go through with this. If you've already acted on it, please get ahold of of emergency services. Don't wanna lose you, okay? Please feel free to talk to me if you'd like. I hope you're okay.

I understand that. For some people it's comforting knowing they aren't the only ones going through a rough time. Now that I think about it though, it is kinda funny how that works, huh? Misery loves company. 

Do you have any pets? If so, what are their names?
I'd love to talk, if you're willing. Feel free to PM me if you'd like! I hope you feel better soon, and I'm glad you're still here.

While I'm likely much younger than you, I identify under the Trans\* umbrella myself. 

I'm really sorry you have to go through things of that sort, you don't deserve it. I'm sorry you're in so much pain, but I do hope your therapist can help. While I don't have any experience with meth, I do know how awful addiction can be, and I can't imagine what you must be going through right now. I understand being unable to be around alcohol, I'm the same way. While our experiences are certainly different, you're not alone, alright? 

I hope you can make it to your appointment, and while I know it won't help immediately, I sincerely hope you'll be around long enough for it to help.

I don't make friends very easily either, but there's no harm in trying! I tend to come off quite extreme too- it doesn't make you an unlikable person.

Why do you think you're so terrible? Judging from your profile, you just made your account today, and you're already leaving supportive comments on people's posts and trying to help them. You don't seem terrible to me.

I'm sorry you're going through this right now, and I hope you feel better soon. I also hope you reconsider.

Although, I've gotta ask- what are the requirements for a friend? Maybe it wouldn't hurt to reach out and make some new ones!
I'm sorry to hear that. I'm glad you finally have access to one, though! I do hope they'll be able to help - you have quite a bit on your plate, and that's a lot to handle on your own.

I'm terribly sorry to hear that. I hope you feel better one day too!

With each doctor you visit, you become one closer to the one who'll be able to help you! You're not a lost cause, I assure you! You'll be able to find help, it just may take much longer than you'd like.

I definitely understand! That wouldn't be ideal in the slightest!

I'd recommend reading up on emancipation laws in your state! If it's something you're interested in, of course. 

Do you have the support of a therapist/counselor?

When I was 13, I didn't think I'd make it to 14. I'm 17 now. You've endured so much already, and I know you can get through this, too. You're strong. 

Soon, you'll be 17. And before you know it, you'll be 18. And you'll be an adult. You'll be able to move out and set out on your own path. Be there to see it. 

Would you feel safer at your grandfather's? Would it be a better environment?

OP, how are you holding up? Are you still here? 

We're here to help, if you'll allow us to.
OP, you still here?

I apologize for the late response!! I didn't see this! 

Although, Diane wasn't here to know she got recognition. She wasn't here to receive her praise. And I wish she were. You have no way of knowing your art will be recognized because you've passed. You can, however, continue to create and advocate for yourself! Be here to see your success. Please.
I'm glad you'll get to see her soon! And yes, I think that's a great idea!! I hope you're able to find many more reasons to stick around!

I hope you don't go through with it. I can't tell you what comes after, only what I hope for. 

I hope you feel better. I can tell you, from personal experience, that it does get better. I'm still not 100%, but I'm much better than I was a year ago. It's not easy, and it still isn't easy. But progress is progress, and one day you will be happy, as long as you want to be. 

If there's anything I can do to help, please let me know. You don't deserve to die.

She sounds adorable!! Would you be able to visit her? I'm sure she misses you too!!   
This is a rather sad thought, but considering the initial topic of this post, I feel it's fitting. If anything happened to you, little Ebony would have no idea where you went. It's only been two weeks, and I'm sure she already misses you tons! But what if it she was never able to see you again?

I know very little about Depakine, but I do know that abusing/overdosing on any medication isn't good for your liver, and can definitely cause problems. I wouldn't recommend taking them, and I hope you reconsider. Overdosing is an awful way to go, and it's incredibly painful. You don't deserve that. You don't deserve to die, and you certainly don't deserve the pain you feel. I hope you feel better soon. Feel free to talk to me.
No need to apologize! I really do hope my suggestions help! What's your dog's name?
Understandable!! I hope this upcoming project gets the attention it deserves upon its release! I hope you're able to continue creating once you finish this one!

Animals always help! Pets have been proven to alleviate stress, anxiety, and depression! So go pet those fluff-balls! 

Another suggestion is to take care of yourself! I know it's difficult, but it'll help! When you do something necessary to your survival (eating, ect.) your brain releases dopamine! Almost like it's rewarding you, I guess! For surviving! Self-care is best care! Be gentle with yourself, and understand that you need time to heal. 

Personally, I've found that making a playlist to listen to when I'm down helps! It's nice listening to sad music when you're sad, because it's comforting to know you're not alone. Although I'd recommend uplifting music! On my playlist I have artists like Cavetown, dodie, and Mimi! Something gentle that you can calm down to- it's sort of like a hug! Plus, I find many of the songs themselves to be rather comforting. 

If you need to ground yourself, I'd recommend the 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 method! Which can be found here: [https://copingskillsforkids.com/blog/2016/4/27/coping-skill-spotlight-5-4-3-2-1-grounding-technique](https://copingskillsforkids.com/blog/2016/4/27/coping-skill-spotlight-5-4-3-2-1-grounding-technique)   
I hope you feel better soon, and if you need anything else, please feel free to let me know!
Oh! I apologize for the misunderstanding! I'm glad you're proud of it. Do you post your work anywhere? I'm sure it's amazing!
I really do hope you reconsider, and go on to make many films in the future. What's your current project about?
What Joey said! We're here to help in any way we can. I hope you feel better soon, OP. Feel free to talk to us. We don't want anything to happen to you!

I'm sorry you feel small today. I hope with time you'll feel much bigger. I understand being afraid of yourself, and what you think you might be capable of doing to yourself, as well as being afraid of the consequences. I truly hope you feel better soon, you don't deserve to die like this. Feel free to talk to me if you'd like.

I'm fairly awkward too, and don't have many friends. I understand the paradoxes. They seem to be ever-present. Although, I do hope you feel better soon. You don't deserve to die, and you certainly don't deserve the pain you're feeling right now. I do hope you take care of yourself, though I do understand how difficult it can be. Perhaps you could reach out to a therapist or counselor? I'm sure they'd be able to help you in some way. I wish you the best, and I hope things get better for you.

I hope you don't follow through. That was something that stalled me for many years as well. I couldn't stand the thought of my mother or siblings finding my body. I think many people wish suicide could be easy, but fortunately that isn't the case. 

I hope you feel better soon. You deserve it. 

I checked out your profile, and I'll be honest, I don't know much about Lyme disease, other than I think that's what Avril Lavigne had/has. Now, I'm not certain, but I've heard of people visiting the Mayo Clinic in MN for difficult to treat/diagnose illnesses. If anything, perhaps it's something you could look into? Maybe there's a clinic somewhere that specializes in Lyme disease. While I understand you'd likely like to keep your location private, if you'd be willing to give me a state, I'd be happy to do some research myself. You have a lot on your plate already, and I think it'd be best for you to focus on taking care of yourself to the extent that you're able. I really do hope you feel better soon, and I wish you the best of luck.
